snippet.title: Beholder: Conductor | Console Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/beholder-conductor-switch/
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019096
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/beholder-conductor/9p1f891m62td

A Beholder series spin-off. Become a conductor of the Determination Bringer train: monitor passengers, report incidents, and carry out important Ministry assignments — whose level of secrecy depends only on your loyalty. And remember: mission success is very important to you!

Follow Beholder on Twitter: https://x.com/Beholder_Game
Join our Discord server:  https://discord.gg/alawar
